visual_elements.description: Embedded screenshot of a hand-drawn-style neural-network / backpropagation diagram on a light beige (#E8DCD0) panel, placed as a wide landscape region at x ~36%-79%, y ~11%-41% of the slide. Structure left to right: (1) three small solid magenta (#CC00CC) input dots stacked vertically at the far left, each fanning out via thin light-gray (#BFBFBF) lines to the next column; (2) a column of three white (#FFFFFF) circles outlined in red (#C00000), each containing a red 'Σ'; from each 'Σ' a right-pointing arrow labeled italic red 'f' leads to a small circle labeled 'o' followed by two small empty circles; (3) a second column of three white circles with red 'Σ'; (4) a column of three green (#00A651) circles containing green 'Σ'; (5) a column of three green squares labeled 'f' followed by three green squares labeled 'o'; (6) three white rectangular boxes with thin black (#000000) outlines labeled 'Output 1', 'Output 2', and 'Output m'. Red italic weight labels 'w_ij' sit on the forward arrows between the middle 'Σ' column and the green 'Σ' column; blue (#0070C0) italic labels 'w_ji' sit on blue backward-pointing arrows in the same region; red italic 'w_jk' labels sit on the arrows from the green 'Σ' column to the green 'f' squares. Magenta (#CC00CC) diagonal error-path lines cross the middle of the network; the exact count is not specified [?]. Along the top edge are three yellow (#FFFF00) filled circles labeled 'w_ij', 'w_jk', and 'w_ki' in red, linked by black curved arrows arching rightward. Along the bottom edge: a blue upward-pointing arrow under the middle 'Σ' column, a solid purple (#CC00CC) circle containing a white 'L', and a green double-headed vertical arrow under the green 'Σ' column. Bottom-left corner: a small purple circular 'N' logo followed by the purple text 'Nikhil Sree'.
